detail.description: What the title cannot carry: the context a person or an agent needs to start.

state.description: A new task starts ready. It moves only through tasks.start, tasks.hand, tasks.release, tasks.submit, tasks.accept and tasks.send_back — never by writing this field.

assignee.description: The actor working it. Set by tasks.start or tasks.hand.

origin.description: filed: a person wrote it down. triggered: an agent filed it off an event.

human_only.description: Why this needs a person. Set, no agent may take it.

criteria.title: Definition of done
criteria.description: The definition of done. Empty means no agent can take this task — not as a policy, but because there would be nothing for it to verify against before filing.

moved_at.description: When it entered its current state — how long a review has waited is read from this.

question.title: Question for a person
question.description: What the one working it stopped to ask a person. Set by tasks.question, cleared by tasks.answer.

produced.title: What it produced
produced.description: What the work produced, named when it was filed for review.

review.title: Review
review.description: Who filed it for review and what the reviewer decided.

ask_seq.description: The `asked` event an agent assignee is answering; its run is the run with this trigger_seq.
